statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: For every x in X and pi* with P c(x) >= 0 and (P c(x))_pi = 0 for pi in {1,2,4,6,7,8} (non-strict: extra contacts allowed), Phi_{c(x)}(O) >= 0 for all O in SO(4). No restriction on the spectra: the proof only uses that Re x (height restored) satisfies C = 0 and det Hess C = 0, which holds for every x in X, including repeated eigenvalues and a_i+b_j=0.
